title: You Have to Dance Like Nobody's Watching (Even After They Start)
description:
There's a version of you that exists only when nobody's watching. Not a better version — an unfiltered one.

This video is built around a poem I almost didn't share, and the paradox underneath the quote everyone knows: dancing like nobody's watching eventually creates an audience. And then the watching changes the dance.

I talk about what made the pieces that actually landed — why the rough drafts worked better than the polished ones — and the small practice I use to stay close to that unselfconscious place.
